after: PGOOD = (((qualify_counter == TARGET) | ((qualify_counter == PGOOD_DELAY_W'(PGOOD_DELAY_CYCLES - 1)) & pwm_fall)) & pgood_comp & run_active);
proposal.description: PGOOD looks ahead to the counter's next value: it asserts on the PWM falling edge that will take the counter to TARGET, instead of once the counter has reached it
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with the comparator good for the whole qualifying period, PGOOD rises one clock early, on the clock where pwm_fall fires and the counter still holds TARGET-1. PGOOD also shows a one-clock pulse on that same clock if the counter is held at TARGET-1 and the comparator or run_active drops right after it.
